trial_court: ACJM, Ranchi (Complaint Case No.10418 of 2021 under DV Act)
case_name: Smt. Vimla Devi vs State Of Jharkhand

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt. Vimla Devi, Sri Laxmi Das (mother-in-law and father-in-law)
parties.respondent_defendant: State of Jharkhand, Sumana Sharan @ Suman Sharan

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Complainant filed complaint against husband and in-laws for domestic violence; she was subjected to cruelty and dowry demand while living in U.S.A.

legal_principles.principle: Divorce granted by a court in USA has no application in view of settled law.
legal_principles.held: It is held that divorce granted by the Court in USA between the parties shall have no application.
cited_cases: Y. Narasimha Rao & Ors. vs. V. Venkata Lakshmi and Anr., (1991) 3 SCC 451

legal_principles.principle: Any relief available under the Domestic Violence Act, 2005 may also be sought in any legal proceeding.
legal_principles.held: Any relief available under Sections 18, 19, 20, 21 and 22 may also be sought in any legal proceeding...
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005
cited_cases: Smt. Vimla Devi vs State Of Jharkhand (2023)

outcome.result: Instant petition has been filed for quashing of entire criminal proceeding

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
